arguments.query: small business need help with data analysis or reporting

results.text: A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
A newsletter publisher wonders which recurring questions in its archive would justify a focused guide.

arguments.scope: Review the repair business's public-facing descriptions (website, listings, social pages) of its standard service, identify inconsistencies and the recurring customer questions they cause, and deliver a single clear, consistent service-description document (what's included/excluded, pricing basis, turnaround) plus a short FAQ addressing the top recurring questions, ready to paste into the business's site/listings.
